title: occ20200331_8k.htm
主要内容: The annual meeting of shareholders of Optical Cable Corporation (OCC) held on April 1, 2020, resulted in the ratification of Brown, Edwards & Company, L.L.P. as the independent registered public accounting firm. The vote for ratification received 6,076,522 votes for, 82,608 against, and 149,841 abstentions. Additionally, the compensation of the named executive officers was approved on a non-binding advisory basis, with 4,548,373 votes for, 136,093 against, and 33,765 abstentions. There were also 1,590,740 broker non-votes. No other matters were voted upon.
